preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The input edges form a valid connected undirected tree.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimal time required for all ants starting at leaves to reach the root, calculated as the maximum over all leaves of (depth of leaf + number of other leaves in the same subtree that are at the same or greater depth relative to the leaf's path to root, effectively the bottleneck capacity constraint).
